title: ID0382007-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117111] Socket holder broken
description:
We are experiencing a quality issue with the socket holders. During our site visits, we identified that the plastic had broken. We believe that these plastics should not break this easily.
We plan to replace them, but we are wondering if this will be covered under warranty.
